author: Kamil Mete Yalcinkaya
description: Detects a cron entry being created that invokes a network client or an interpreter. Package managers install cron jobs too, so the payload rather than the write is what makes this interesting.
false_positives: Configuration management such as Ansible or Puppet writing cron entries. Filter on the parent process of the automation agent.
name: Cron Persistence Written Outside Package Management
query: ((process.command_line : "*crontab -*" or process.command_line : "*/etc/cron.d/*" or process.command_line : "*/var/spool/cron/*") and (process.command_line : "*curl*" or process.command_line : "*wget*" or process.command_line : "*/dev/tcp/*" or process.command_line : "*base64*" or process.command_line : "*python*" or process.command_line : "*perl*" or process.command_line : "*bash -i*") and not (process.parent.name : "dpkg" or process.parent.name : "apt" or process.parent.name : "rpm" or process.parent.name : "yum" or process.parent.name : "dnf"))
